mapper.select: SELECT id, name, email, phone, password, promo_code, role, status, token_version, created_at, updated_at FROM users WHERE LOWER(email) = LOWER(#{email})
SELECT id, name, email, phone, password, promo_code, role, status, token_version, created_at, updated_at FROM users WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO users (name, email, phone, password, promo_code, role, status, token_version) VALUES (#{name}, #{email}, #{phone}, #{password}, #{promoCode}, #{role}, #{status}, #{tokenVersion})
mapper.update: UPDATE users SET password = #{password} WHERE id = #{id}
